title: MaI zainab hoon
body:
Haye..
<<MINI>>
Wawaila.. Sad Wawaila
Wawaila.. Sad Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham e ghareeba'n
khaak pe kunba
zakhmi payro se chal chalke
zainab deti hai pehra
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha ke sawaar aata hai koi
zainab yu tadap kar chillayi
ab lootne ko kya hai baaqi?
awaaz sawaar ki ye aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
pehchan tera baba hu ali
baba se lipat kar di ye sada
ghar ujad gaya mera kuch na raha
mera kuch na raha, mera kuch na raha
<<MINI>>
haye tukde tukde dil mera..(2)
Ye maqtal hai, mai zainab hu..(2)
Wawaila.. Sad Wawaila
Wawaila.. Sad Wawaila
Wawaila... Hussain, Hussain, Hussain, Hussain
Sad wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kaisi ye khiza'n aayi baba
mai kuch na bacha payi baba
na chadar na ghazi baba
na mera raha bhai baba
<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ujda hai, dil rota hai..(2)
hai khoon mein tar lashkar saara
<<MINI>>

2. Mai bhen athara veeran di
pardesich baba ujad gayi
darda'n di maari di teri
hai matamdar bahattar di
<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
meku de pursa maqtoolan da..(2)
ujdi ku gal gal laa baba

<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ashoor ka din aisa guzra
aabad chaman barbaad hua
pyasa tanha bhai mera
pyaro ke laashe laata raha
<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
kayi baar gira, gir girke utha
mazloom ghareeb e karbobala
<<MINI>>

4. Jado ghazi chadiya ghode ton
mere muk daye naal bhirawan de
teri sharma wali zainab nu
nayi bhulne dard ridawan de
<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba, Baba, meku turna sikha..(2)
me wajnayi shaam nu rassiya pa
<<MINI>>

nayi keeta taras zara baba
na maaro wasite dendi rayi
quran ko sirte jaa baba
<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
nayi bas challiya koi ujdi de..(2)

ye shame ghareeba'n hai baba

koi na raha abid ke siwa
<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
<<DIVIDER>>
waha'n jashn bapa yaha'n aaho buka..(2)

aa seene se lag jaa beti

<<MINI>>
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah
